files.description: Full HTML of the Cost Disclosure and Transparency page — the registered URL for this product's mandatory disclosures. Contains the sole EHI export documentation: a one-sentence footnote stating exports are in PDF or C-CDA format. Also includes vendor/product info, certification criteria table, cost transparency details, and links to the InteropEngine FHIR API.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://ulrichmedicalconcepts.com/home/the-ehr/meaningful-use/cost-disclosure-and-transparency/' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' -o cost-disclosure-and-transparency.html

files.description: Full-page browser screenshot of the Cost Disclosure and Transparency page, showing the rendered layout including the EHI export footnote, certification criteria table, and cost disclosures.

FHIR R4 endpoint list for UMC customers using the InteropEngine API. Linked from the cost disclosure page under 'Application Access API Additional Information.' Contains only a FHIR Bundle shell with no entries — effectively empty. This is for the g(10) FHIR API, not the b(10) EHI export.
